sourceHints: Agents: StreamingResponse, IStreamingResponse, StreamInfo, TurnContext, CloudAdapterBase, ConversationsRestClient, ProtocolJsonSerializer

checks.description: Trace HTTP methods, route construction, protocol headers, JSON serialization, field names and omission rules through dispatch.
Compare initial and repeated informative updates, their payloads, ordering, and relationship to stream creation.
Compare accumulated text updates with and without an initial informative update, including activity types, stream IDs and sequences.
Compare final messages, supplied final activity overrides, stream metadata, idempotency, and empty streams.
Compare starting a second streaming sequence, identifiers, sequences, and emitted requests.
Compare optional attachments and cards in streaming and final payloads.
Compare citation entities, reference filtering, and text transformations on the wire.
Compare AI labels and sensitivity metadata, including optional entity omission.
Compare feedback metadata placement and serialization.
Compare requests emitted or suppressed after client cancellation and caller cancellation.
Compare timeout recognition and outbound fallback, including POST versus update.
Compare behavior when streaming is unavailable, including final buffered delivery.
Compare ordering, coalescing, throttling, and retries only where they affect observable requests or protocol compliance.
